policy.duration: strict elapsed > document limit; two consecutive fully qualifying observations
policy.gap: report; reset pending state; truncate active event as unconfirmed, never recovered
policy.drift: signed current minus exact historical observation; complete contiguous fixed window
policy.drift_direction: positive increase only; no absolute-value conversion
policy.drift_maint02: 30+ min operationalized as fixed 30-minute lookback, NOT >1A held 30min
policy.unknown: external candidate only; no automatic discovery; expert review required
policy.recovery: document-recommended response only; no execution or confirmed cause

evaluation: same-sensor zero-grace overlap; coverage + confirmed-alarm-in-gold-window; merged alarm episodes one-to-one maximum matching
label_access: only evaluator after all output seals; previous team result exposure disclosed
